description: Defines a priority-based concurrent task queue class with associated methods, including priority conversion functions, consumer interface, and queue management functionalities within the ocudu::detail namespace.

classes.name: priority_task_queue
classes.description: A concurrent, priority-based task queue supporting multiple priority levels, with blocking and non-blocking push/pop operations, and consumer interface.

classes.name: priority_task_queue::consumer_type
classes.description: A non-thread-safe consumer interface for popping tasks from the priority_task_queue.

classes.name: any_task_queue
classes.description: Type-erased interface for a concurrent queue, used internally.

classes.name: any_task_consumer
classes.description: Type-erased consumer interface for a task queue, used internally.

methods.name: enqueue_priority_to_queue_index
methods.description: Converts enqueue priority to queue index based on the number of priority levels.

methods.name: queue_index_to_enqueue_priority
methods.description: Converts queue index back to enqueue priority.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::consumer_type::try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task from the queue without blocking.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::consumer_type::try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple tasks in bulk without blocking.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::consumer_type::pop_blocking
methods.description: Pops a task, blocking if necessary, until a task is available.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes a task into the queue, blocking if the queue is full.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push a task into the queue without blocking; returns false if full.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a task considering priority; returns false if empty.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple tasks considering priority; returns number of tasks popped.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::pop_blocking
methods.description: Blocks until a task is available to pop, considering priority.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::queue_capacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the queue at a given priority level.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::size
methods.description: Returns the total number of pending tasks.

methods.name: priority_task_queue::create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for the queue.
